scientific_integrity: The domain is complete bipartite graphs with all-original-edge vertex-sum inequalities; numerical extremal endpoints previously established elsewhere are acknowledged; finite exact verification supplements a combinatorial proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete support polynomial for unbalanced bicliques is not determined; some closely related 2026 sources were inspectable at abstract level only; independent mathematical and bibliographic audit not performed.
title: Sparse and nearly complete binary vertex-colouring edge-weightings of bicliques
